cases.purpose: pidof -c reports only processes whose root directory equals the caller's root: a chrooted process is excluded under -c and included without it, a process with the caller's root is included under both.
cases.oracle: sysvinit-utils 3.14 pidof run by the reference bash side against the same fixture processes (root user inside a mapped user and mount namespace, owned python children, one chrooted into an empty directory)
cases.comparison: Byte parity of status and stdout (PIDs mapped to fixture tags).
